content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a few minor adjustments before we proceed. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment conditions, your payments are conditional upon government registrations being completed, which delays your receipt of funds; please update it to: Payments due under this Agreement shall be made by the Client within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment timing, payment is due within 45 days of invoice, which is later than the standard 30-day payment term; please change it to: Except for Article 3.1 hereabove, payments shall be made by wire transfer to the bank nominated by the Licensor within thirty (30) days after the issuance by the Licensor of the corresponding invoices. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property ownership, the intellectual property, data, and know-how arising from further development work become sole property immediately upon creation without any condition requiring full payment first; we suggest this modification: Any intellectual property, know-how, trade secrets, data, and processes arising from the Further Development Work and the Supplemental Data shall remain the property of the Licensee until full payment is received from the Licensor. Thank you for your time and understanding.
